point_context:
## Why They See It Differently

All three want the right person in the right job. Yet the applicant may lose a fair chance; recruiter must keep work moving and explain it; owner must keep company running and answer for the choice. Power differs: applicant cannot choose the system, recruiter operates it without deciding adoption, and owner may make the final call. NYC’s fairness check, public summary, and notice requirements constrain all three: recruiter cannot use it silently, owner cannot rely on speed alone, and applicant cannot control the score. They cannot simply yield one answer.
